text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a Q3 tranche to deprecate the legacy enrichment-service and migrate tenants to enrich-v2. Want alignment on sequencing + safety rails. TL;DR: 6-week window, canary, fallback policy.
sophia: Sounds good. Quick questions: how are we thinking about KV cache ownership during the migration? Also what metrics are we using to sign off correctness?
ryan: Proposing tranche ordering by qps and error-sensitivity. Start with low-qps, non-critical tenants. We'll need a sidecar shim for ~2 weeks to normalize requests.
alex: Sidecar shim plan: proxy semantic compatibility, emit warning headers, and send telemetry. Fallback to enrich-legacy if latency > 200ms or error-rate spikes > 1% for 5m.
elaine: SLA owners — is 200ms acceptable for paid tiers? For some customers we should aim for 150ms.
sophia: We can make per-tenant thresholds in the rollout config and gate by billing tier. ops-bot can enforce environment flags.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary image enrich-v2:tag-2024-07-25 deployed to canary pool (2 GPUs). Monitoring alerts created for latency, 5xx, and regression evals.
ryan: Draft migration runbook (short):
1) register tenant in feature-flag
2) enable shim in staging + run smoke
3) mirror traffic -> enrich-v2 for correctness checks
4) ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24-72h windows
5) cutover and enable safe-slab retention for 30 days
Commands:
```bash
./flagctl enroll tenant-42 --env=staging
```
alex: Need billing events for token/cost delta surfaced in console during ramp. Also add an opt-out for customers during the canary.
sophia: On the tech-debt side — we should delete the old enrichment transforms after 3 months of zero traffic and a changelog entry. That frees up the transform-service boundary cleanup.
elaine: To avoid regressions, add an eval prompt set and regression alerts tied to prompts + per-tenant perf thresholds.
ryan: Will add evals and baseline metrics. Also propose a "safe-slab" where legacy code stays compiled but only used for fallback for 30 days post-cutover. After that we prune.
alex: Action items:
- Ryan: runbook + eval sets (ETA 3d)
- Sophia: quota/billing update and UI flags (ETA 4d)
- Elaine: finalize SLA thresholds and rollback criteria (ETA 2d)
- Infra/Ops: sidecar build + canary rollout (ops-bot doing deploy)
I'll schedule a follow-up sync (two days) to check progress.
ops-bot: calendar-bot: Meeting created: Architecture sync — Service portfolio tranche — 2024-07-27 10:00 PDT
sophia: :thumbsup: I'll own the billing changes.
